name: Alpengasthof Schneeberg
beschreibung: The Alpengasthof Schneeberg is a traditional inn in the municipality of Thiersee in the Tyrolean lowlands. It boasts a quiet setting on the edge of the village, offering views of the surrounding mountains and Lake Thiersee. The accommodation features rooms with contemporary comfort along with a dining lounge serving regional Tyrolean cuisine. A special highlight is the use of produce sourced from their own farm and local suppliers. The inn serves as a base for hikes in summer and ski tours in winter. The interior harmoniously blends traditional alpine ambience with modern conveniences. Guests can look forward to attentive personal service in a peaceful, natural environment.
